Types of necklines every woman should know!
Round neck. Simple, classic, and so easy.
V-neck. Makes your neck look longer.
Scoop. A soft, deep curve. Very feminine.
Boat neck. Wide and straight, from shoulder to shoulder.
Square. Straight lines with a clean, modern look.
Sweetheart. Curved like the top of a heart.
Collar. Smart and crisp, just like a shirt.
Cowl. Soft fabric that drapes in folds.
Off-shoulder. Shows off your shoulders. Party ready!
And the classy one... the high neck! Covered, chic, and so elegant.
